notes: Channel ID formula (from ISAPI guide): ID = (channel_number × 100) + stream_type, where stream_type 1=main, 2=sub, 3=third. For a single-channel IP camera, channel 1 gives IDs 101 (main), 102 (sub), 103 (third). NVR channel N gives IDs N01/N02/N03. Two documented path variants exist: (1) /Streaming/Channels/<ID> — used in Hikvision Support KB articles, no ISAPI prefix; (2) /ISAPI/Streaming/channels/<ID> — from the ISAPI Developer Guide, canonical API form. Default RTSP port is 554. Credentials are passed as rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/... — Hikvision also mentions port 10554 for authenticated streams on some firmware. Many leads in the candidate list are clearly from other brands (Axis media.amp, Foscam .sdp with credentials in URL, Dahua ch0_0.h264) — all excluded. PSIA paths (/PSIA/Streaming/channels/...) are a legacy predecessor to ISAPI and not in current official documentation.
